plates.street: a Manila street outside the old stone walls of Intramuros in the afternoon, a parked motorcycle with a square insulated delivery box on the back, acacia trees, a stone gate in the distance, warm afternoon sunlight.
plates.baluarte: the ruins of an old Spanish colonial stone bastion in Intramuros Manila today, thick weathered grey-brown volcanic stone walls and circular stone ruins, green lawn and tropical garden, a small blank stone plaque on a pedestal, golden late-afternoon light, long shadows.
plates.siege: the old Spanish colonial stone bastion wall of Manila in 1762 under bombardment, a ragged breach in the wall, rubble, gunpowder smoke, orange smoky sky.
plates.hall: the interior of a dim Spanish colonial stone hall in 1762 at night, thick stone arches, heavy wooden table with candles, tall shuttered windows glowing orange from fires outside, smoke haze.
plates.bacolor: a Philippine provincial town in Pampanga in 1762 at sunrise, nipa and bamboo houses on stilts, coconut palms, green rice fields, a dirt road, distant blue mountain, hopeful golden morning light.

full.intro: Golden time portal of plain gear rims and light behind, no faces, no letters. Waist-up: a young Filipino man, about twenty, lean, warm brown skin, tousled black hair tied in a small topknot, red cloth headband with long tails, wearing a loose off-white cotton collarless baro shirt with rolled sleeves, a round bronze medallion on a cord around his neck, one indigo geometric tattoo on his right forearm, dark brown eyes, arms crossed, confident smile, and sitting beside him a medium-sized black Philippine street dog with a white chest patch, one folded ear and bright clever eyes, a red kerchief around his neck.
full.medallion: extreme close-up of an old round bronze medallion engraved with a sun and a triangle, on a worn cord, hanging alone in the air against a dark background, glowing bright gold with sparks and light rays. No hand, no people.
full.ships: a fleet of eighteenth-century wooden sailing warships with tall masts and white sails in a tropical bay, firing broadsides, flashes and white smoke from the gun ports along the ship sides, no loose cannons, nothing on the water but the ships, a walled stone city on the distant shore, dramatic orange sky. No people.
full.wallfall: a section of thick low sloping Spanish colonial stone bastion wall bursting from a cannonball hit, flying stones, fire flash, dust and smoke, dramatic low angle, orange sky, no cannon in the picture. No people.
full.city: a walled Spanish colonial stone city by a tropical bay at dusk in 1762, columns of black smoke rising from inside the walls, church towers in silhouette, red sunset, sailing warships in the bay. No people.
full.coins: extreme close-up of an open wooden chest overflowing with plain worn silver coins on a wooden table, candle light, one white-gloved hand in a red sleeve reaching into the chest, a thumb and four fingers clearly separate. Coins with blank faces, no letters.
full.quill: close-up of a white feather quill standing in a brass inkwell beside a sheet of blank cream paper sealed with a red wax seal and ribbon, on a polished wooden desk, candlelight, an eighteenth-century European room blurred behind. Blank paper, no writing, no letters, no marks. No hands, no people. Single image, no panels, no border, the picture fills the whole vertical frame.
full.leave: eighteenth-century wooden sailing warships sailing away toward the horizon of a tropical bay at sunrise, seen from behind old stone walls, calm golden sea, birds. No people.
full.tattoo: Close-up of a brown-skinned forearm raised in a loose fist in front of old stone walls at sunset, orange jacket sleeve pushed up to the elbow, two separate small indigo geometric diamond tattoos on the forearm, one above the other, the upper one glowing faint gold. Only the arm is in frame, no face.
full.phone: extreme close-up of a brown hand holding a smartphone, a thumb with a nail and four fingers, the screen showing only a big green check mark and a plain smooth gold coin with a blank face, plain screen, no numbers, no letters, no symbols, no icons, glowing in dusk light, old stone wall blurred behind. Single image, no panels, no border. No dog, no animals.
